name: fix_github_actions_missing_checkout
description: Adds the missing actions/checkout so the workflow has source to build
prompts: This workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) sets up Node and runs `npm ci` / `npm test`, but it never checks out the repository - so there's no package.json or source in the runner and every run fails. Fix the workflow by adding an actions/checkout step as the FIRST step of the build job, before setup-node and the npm commands. Keep everything else the same.

setup_files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # BUG: no actions/checkout - the repo is never cloned, so npm ci
      # fails with 'no package.json'.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

test_setup_files.test_checkout.py:
import yaml
def load_yaml(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f)

wf = load_yaml('.github/workflows/ci.yml')
steps = wf['jobs']['build']['steps']
uses = [s.get('uses', '') for s in steps]

checkout_idx = next((i for i, u in enumerate(uses) if 'actions/checkout' in u), None)
assert checkout_idx is not None, 'actions/checkout still missing'

setup_idx = next((i for i, u in enumerate(uses) if 'actions/setup-node' in u), None)
assert setup_idx is not None, 'setup-node vanished'
assert checkout_idx < setup_idx, 'checkout must come before setup-node'

# checkout must precede any npm command
npm_idx = next((i for i, s in enumerate(steps) if 'npm' in s.get('run', '')), None)
assert npm_idx is not None and checkout_idx < npm_idx, 'checkout must precede the npm steps'
print('PASS')

reference_solution..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
